newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn steady, HRW wheat offers up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn steady, HRW wheat offers up.

text.p: FOB Gulf corn basis values were mostly steady on Monday while soybean offers were flat to slightly higher by one to two cents a bushel.
Hard red winter wheat CIF offers rose amid continued slow movement from producing areas in the High Plains.

In export news, Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Saturday he bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, 150,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat and 50,000 tonnes of Australian soft white wheat.
Algeria seeks 100,000 tonnes of French and/or U.S. and/or Argentine soft wheat for shipment in second half of December.
